description: This Java class defines Cucumber hooks that manage WebDriver lifecycle, logging, and scenario setup/teardown for tests in the OrangeHRM project. It handles driver initialization, configuration logging, screenshot capture on failure, and scenario-specific logic based on tags.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Cucumber hook class for managing WebDriver lifecycle, logging, and scenario setup/teardown in OrangeHRM test automation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MDC logging, logs scenario info and configuration, and conditionally initializes WebDriver based on scenario tags and configuration.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Handles scenario completion tasks, including capturing screenshot on failure, logging outcome, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: logConfigOnce
methods.description: Thread-safe method that logs the full configuration summary exactly once per test run.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the current WebDriver state and attaches it to the Cucumber report, handling cases where the driver is not initialized.
